title: SQL Server integrated: ADD COLUMN cancels the running update and restarts it (no full refresh)

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: SQL Server 2022 CU27, integrated CDC, one run

symptom: After ADD COLUMN the running update was cancelled: "... due to a schema change ... will be restarted". The flow logged "encountered a schema change during execution and terminated". The pipeline started a new update with cause SCHEMA_CHANGE, and the new column and the new row arrived in it.
cause: Not established: integrated CDC ends the running update at the schema change instead of finishing it.
effect: The update in progress ends early, and the restart replays the table's applier snapshot flow.
fix: No full refresh is needed. Wait for the restarted update before counting rows.
notes: One run. The restart logged the table's snapshot as IN_PROGRESS and ran the applier snapshot flow; no extractor snapshot ran after the change.
